name: Dell S2425H Monitor
notes: HDMI-only video; no USB-C connector in the connectivity list.

name: Dell S2725H Monitor
notes: Use the S2725H column of the shared specifications table.

name: Dell P2225H Monitor
notes: USB-C is downstream charging only, not a video input. The 100 Hz maximum applies to HDMI/DP; VGA maximum is 60 Hz.

name: Dell P2425H Monitor
notes: USB-C is downstream charging only, not a video input. The 100 Hz maximum applies to HDMI/DP; VGA maximum is 60 Hz.

name: Dell P2425 Monitor
notes: 16:10 model P2425 is different from P2425H and P2425E. USB-C downstream only. VGA maximum is 60 Hz.

name: Dell P2725H Monitor
notes: USB-C downstream charging is not laptop video/charging upstream. VGA maximum is 60 Hz.

name: Dell P2425HE Monitor
notes: USB-C upstream supports video and up to 90 W PD. Host and cable must support the required mode.

name: Dell P2425E Monitor
notes: 16:10 USB-C model, distinct from the FHD P2425HE. Up to 90 W host power.

name: Dell P2725HE Monitor
notes: 27-inch FHD USB-C hub model; up to 90 W host power.

name: Dell U2724D Monitor
notes: USB-C upstream is explicitly data only. The 15 W USB-C downstream port is not video input. Do not confuse with U2724DE.

name: Dell U2724DE Monitor
notes: Use the Thunderbolt 4 upstream connector for video and up to 90 W PD. A separate USB-C upstream connector is data only.

name: Dell S2725QC Monitor
notes: 4K USB-C model with up to 65 W host PD. A 100 W rated cable does not mean the monitor provides 100 W.
